question: Will the Skyworks–Qorvo merger close before October 1, 2026?

calls.reasoning: Status quo is NO: as of the latest primary filing (Sept 18, 2026) the merger had not closed and China SAMR clearance — the gating condition, in Phase III — was not in hand, with Korea KFTC possibly also open. Eight US business days remain. The decisive correction to the question's background: Skyworks' fiscal year ends the Friday nearest Sept 30, i.e. Oct 2, 2026, not Sept 30 — so the CEO's 'preparing to close this fiscal year' target explicitly spans Oct 1-2, both of which resolve NO, and Friday Oct 2 is the more natural closing date than Wed Sept 30. Company language on Sept 11 and Sept 18 was still hedged ('hopeful ... within the calendar year', 'no assurances'), and Brace's Sept 10 'waiting around the airport for permission to land' confirms the parties do not control timing. Offsetting evidence: a very tight ~0.45% arb spread, >91% of Qorvo notes tendered, weekly (not monthly) exchange-offer rolls, and Phase III being the final SAMR stage all indicate an imminent, near-certain close. But completion is not the question; completion before Oct 1 is. P(SAMR clears by ~Sept 25-28) ~20%, times P(consummation by Sept 30 | that) ~50% given closing mechanics and the Oct 1-2 pull, gives ~10%. Outside date of April 27, 2027 means no cliff forces September.

As of Sept 18, 2026 China SAMR Phase III and Korea KFTC were both still open with no clearance announced, and Skyworks' own language in its Sept 11/14 425 leads with 'hopeful... within the calendar year,' relegating a fiscal-year close to 'as early as.' Crucially, Skyworks' FY2026 ends Friday Oct 2, 2026 (Q3 ended July 3, 2026), so even the company's stretch target permits an Oct 1-2 close that resolves this NO, and period-boundary closings are the norm. The YES path requires SAMR to clear at its ~Sept 22-26 statutory Phase III deadline (pre-Golden-Week), KFTC to follow, and the parties to consummate within days - historically feasible (Broadcom/VMware closed 1 day after SAMR; Synopsys/Ansys 3 days) but the base rate of a Phase III deadline producing clearance rather than a pull-and-refile in a contentious US-China semiconductor deal is well under half. - 2026-07-28 (Q3 FY26 earnings call) / 2026-07-29 Form 425: SAMR advanced to PHASE III. CEO Phil Brace: 'The Phase III of SAMR is, in fact, the final stage of that process.' Company 'optimistic that we can close within the calendar year, and we will be preparing to close as early as within this fiscal year.' Also announced $2B buyback and elimination of the dividend.
- 2026-08-01/03: HSR waiting period expired and the FTC allowed the parties' Timing Agreement to lapse without further action - US antitrust cleared. Filing states SAMR (China) and KFTC (South Korea) are 'the only jurisdictions that remain open.' (Form 425 filed 2026-08-03; MLex, 2026-08-03)

- Exchange offer expiration date history: 2026-09-01 -> extended to 2026-09-11 -> extended to 2026-09-18 -> extended (announced 2026-09-18) to 2026-09-25. Tenders as of the Sept 18 release: $775.7M of $850M (91.25%) of the 2029 notes; $653.3M of $700M (93.33%) of the 2031 notes. (Skyworks press releases; Quiver Quantitative, 2026-09-18)
- 2026-09-10/11 (Goldman Sachs Communacopia + Technology Conference, filed as Form 425 on 2026-09-14): Brace said the deal is in its 'final stages' with two regulatory jurisdictions remaining; $500M cost synergy target; combined-company CEO to be Brace, Bruggeworth to join the board. Verbatim filing language: 'Skyworks is hopeful that the Mergers will close within the calendar year (subject to satisfaction or waiver of all closing conditions) and is preparing to close as early as within the fiscal year' plus 'there can be no assurances that the closing will occur on this timeline.' SWKS rose ~10% and QRVO ~6% on 2026-09-10.
- As of the most recent filing reviewed (2026-09-18), NO SAMR clearance and NO KFTC clearance has been publicly announced, and no specific closing date has been disclosed.
- CALENDAR NOTE (deciding body): Skyworks' fiscal year is a 52/53-week year; Q3 FY2026 ended 2026-07-03, so FY2026 ends FRIDAY 2026-10-02 - i.e. management's 'within the fiscal year' language permits a close on Oct 1 or Oct 2. Qorvo's fiscal Q2 FY2027 ends on or about 2026-09-26. China's National Day / Golden Week holiday runs Oct 1-8, 2026, during which SAMR does not issue decisions. SAMR does not publish a decision calendar; conditional-clearance decisions are published on the SAMR website when issued, and simple-case unconditional clearances are published in periodic batches.
- STATUTORY CLOCK (China AML): Phase 1 = 30 days from case acceptance, Phase 2 = 90 days, Phase 3 = up to 60 further days (180 days maximum in total). Phase III was already underway by 2026-07-28, which places the statutory Phase III expiry in the second half of September 2026 - but the exact acceptance and Phase III entry dates are NOT public, so this is an inference, not a documented date. At the Phase III deadline, parties who have not agreed remedies conventionally withdraw and refile, restarting the full 180-day clock.

Upward pressure: SAMR is in Phase III (entered ~Aug 2026), whose 60-day statutory clock plausibly expires late Sep/early Oct; financing and exchange offers are fully staged; the arb spread is ~0.45%, consistent with a close expected within weeks. Downward pressure that dominates: as of Sep 18 neither China nor Korea had cleared, no clearance news through Sep 19-21, and consummation by Sep 30 ET requires both clearances inside ~5-6 business days plus closing mechanics. Decisive nuance: Skyworks' fiscal 2026 ends October 2, 2026, so the company's own stretch goal ('within the fiscal year') is met by an Oct 1-2 close, which resolves NO - a large chunk of the probability mass for 'imminent close' lands just past the deadline, and Oct 1 is itself a natural quarter-boundary closing date. Rough decomposition: P(SAMR by ~Sep 29) ~0.33 x P(Korea in time) ~0.85 x P(consummated by Sep 30 given clearances) ~0.70 ~= 0.20.

calls.reconciliation: Factual checks I ran this turn (5 actions): (1) search for SAMR clearance news Sept 2026 — returned only the July/August Phase III and 'optimistic to close within the calendar year' material, no clearance; (2) search for a closing/completion announcement — returned only the Sept 10-11 Goldman 'final stages' coverage and the standard 'only jurisdictions that remain open' language, no closing; (3) fetch of the Skyworks-Qorvo combination page — returned no usable content (empty), so no confirmation either way from the designated resolution source; (4) search for KFTC clearance — found the Aug 3 MLex report that China and Korea both remain open and an earlier KFTC request for additional information, but NO Korean clearance; (5) fetch of the newest 425 my search surfaced (accession 000110465926107167) — it is the Sept 11 exchange-offer extension to Sept 18, containing only 'hopeful that the Mergers will close within the calendar year' boilerplate and no regulator-specific news.
